# QnALog 1.7.5

Organized notes can now be checked against the recording: decisions and action items link to the moment they were said, speakers are marked consistently, and recordings carry a checksum. This release also fixes raw material being copied again on every reorganize.

## Fixed

- **Reorganize no longer copies the raw material.** On a note that has a saved version (for example after Save as new version), each Reorganize added another copy of the original material, and the transcript grew with every run. 1.7.4 and earlier are affected. Reorganize now keeps one copy, and refuses to write — leaving the note, recording and versions unchanged — if the result would contain duplicated transcript blocks, a second "Original material" heading, or more transcript segments without new audio. Notes that already contain copies are not changed automatically.
- **Sidebar speaker names.** After saving a name in the sidebar "Edit speakers" list, the field now shows the saved name.
- **Renaming a speaker twice** now also updates the name in the original transcript.

## Added

- **Sources of decisions and actions.** Organized notes end with a section listing each decision and action item with the speaker, a clickable time link and a short quote from the transcript. Times come from the transcription service; when a service gives only approximate times, the line says "approx." or "approximately in this segment", and without times no link is shown. The sources are selected by the AI model from the transcript, so check them by clicking the time.
- **Speakers are numbered first and named later.** Organizing no longer waits for you to name speakers. Notes use Speaker 1, Speaker 2 until you name them from the notice shown after organizing, the command **Name speakers in the current note**, or the sidebar. Naming updates the properties, the transcript display names and the organized text; the recognized text and speaker IDs in the transcript are not changed.
- **Marked speaker mentions.** In the organized text, speakers are written as 『张华』 in Chinese notes and [Alice] in English notes, before and after naming. Named speakers are no longer listed in the "person attribution check".
- **Recording checksum.** When a recording is saved and verified, or kept audio is imported, QnALog records its SHA-256 checksum and size in the note. The command **Check recording integrity of the current note** compares the file with that record and only reads files. Recordings made before 1.7.5 have no record.

## User impact

- The settings schema version is unchanged. No settings are dropped or changed by the upgrade.
- No need to reconfigure services or API keys.
- Existing notes are not rewritten by the upgrade. The new sources section, speaker marks and checksum appear in notes organized, reorganized or recorded with 1.7.5.
- The organized note now contains short quotes from the transcript (see PRIVACY.md).
- Not yet verified on mobile.
